programs.desc: John 'Ludwig' Taylor lives in solitude, devoting himself to creating puzzles.His twin brother, Chief Inspector James Taylor, disappears.Taylor decides to find him and takes over his identity to do so.

programs.title: Death in Paradise 15
programs.desc: Detective Mervin Wilson (Don Gilet) returns to the charming island of Saint Marie - a tropical corner of the Caribbean full of sun, which, however, hides numerous secrets beneath its idyllic surface.The investigator is still trying to find his place here.He is also taking on further criminal cases.He investigates, among other things, the circumstances of the poisoning of a local newspaper reporter, the alleged attack of a legendary beast on a lecturer, and the death of a professional killer.Additionally, he intervenes when the body of a couples therapist is found on the beach of a luxury resort.Additionally, an unexpected meeting with his stepbrother draws him into a series of unexpected events.

programs.title: Keeping up Appearances 4
programs.desc: Jacynta Bukiet (Patricia Routledge), a pretentious middle-aged woman, wants to be considered a classy woman who only moves in high circles.He does not admit his origins and is ashamed of his poor sisters - Róża and Stokrotka.She plays the lady to her calm and well-behaved neighbor Elizabeth (Josephine Tewson) and her brother Emmet (David Griffin).This leads to many comic situations.Jacinta's husband, Richard (Clive Swift), is embarrassed by his wife's behavior, but for peace of mind he puts up with all the strangeness.
